purpose: provenance of the inputs of the ice sheet mass balance closure's firn and surface mass balance data root: the two ITS_LIVE product files that carry GEMB output on AWS, the documents and registry records read to describe them, and the files read during the search that turned out to carry no GEMB field
credentials: none used: the its-live-data bucket, nsidc.org, cmr.earthdata.nasa.gov, doi.org and api.crossref.org served every file read without a token; the Earthdata Login token in the environment was not sent and is not recorded here

documents_read.what_was_read: section 1.2.2 (variables fac, fac_err, fac_mean, smb, smb_err, smb_mean in m and m per yr, 104 by 2916 by 2916), 1.3 (EPSG:3031, 1920 m, ulxmap -2798407.5 m), 1.4 (17 March 1992 to 16 December 2017, quarterly), 2.3.1.3 (GEMB calibrated after Ligtenberg and others 2011 and Gardner and others 2023, forced with 3-hourly ERA5 for 1979 to 2017 after a relaxation simulation, daily output converted to monthly and interpolated onto a 5 km grid), 3 (version 1.0, initial release), 6 (references)
the variable table (glacier_basin adapted from MEaSUREs Antarctic Boundaries version 2, height from the Copernicus DEM); no GEMB, firn or surface mass balance passage

the 2019 beta (v0) note for the ice shelf melt product: 960 m grid, quarterly (a 5-month centred average every 3 months), firn air content named among the corrections; superseded by the version 1 user guide above and not relied on

the dataset list (Antarctic elevation change, Greenland elevation change 1992 to 2023 at 1920 m EPSG:3413 monthly, Antarctic ice shelf height change and basal melt), the citations and the NSIDC links; no GEMB product page

bucket_listings.prefixes_listed: the top level and height_change, mass_change, ice_masks, documentation, NSIDC, autorift_parameters, composites, datacubes, velocity_mosaic, qgis_project, rgb_mosaics, stac-ingest, catalog_geojson and test-space to two or three levels; gemb, GEMB, firn and smb as prefixes hold no key
bucket_listings.finding: GEMB output appears only inside the two height_change product files above

notes: The ITS_LIVE distribution on AWS carries no GEMB surface mass balance for Greenland and no GEMB field of any kind over the grounded Antarctic ice sheet; the Antarctic rows of this root cover the floating ice shelves and are labelled so in their domain column.

The ice shelf product's last quarter (time value 2017-12-16) carries no finite fac or smb over the shelves and is skipped as a non-sample by both loaders; the stamps list it under empty_steps_skipped.

The ice shelf product's fac_err field is not used: its values run to tens of metres at the median with 9999 where it has none, and its units attribute (m of ice per year) contradicts the user guide (m); the firn stamp records its percentiles and the Antarctic firn uncertainty is the stated noise floor instead.
The Greenland product carries no forcing attribute for its GEMB 1.3.0 run and no user guide was found for it on nsidc.org or in the bucket; the stamp leaves the forcing unstated rather than assumed.
